from:
Read **Same Digits, Different Values — Decimals** with a partner or use read-aloud. Explore **Key Words**, then play Matching and Memory. Use **Keep the Ideas Clear** as a reference. Try **Sort and Explain**, **Explain Your Thinking**, and **Check Your Understanding**. Use **Remember the Ideas** to build a memory cue. Read **Questions to Explore**, then complete **Try It with Evidence**.

Explain an answer using a detail from the lesson. Images are planned for a later edition; every activity works with text now.

Picture panels: Parts of the same whole; Compare and rename; Check a representation; Explain with evidence. Exact grids represent amounts; cartoons provide context only and are not scale drawings. In the sorting pictures, all ten small hundred-grids together form one whole of 1,000 equal cells. Enlarge images to inspect single cells. Colored cells are read left to right within each small grid, then through the top row of grids before the bottom row.
